title: Localization handoff gap
summary: Simulate the maintainer of a critical translation becoming unavailable before a release.

trigger.description: A release needs a translated change but the normal reviewer cannot respond.

assumptions: Translation ownership is a project continuity concern when it gates release communication.
Fallback review must preserve the project's language quality expectations.

inputs.name: translation_owners
inputs.description: Reviewed backup owners for supported locales.

score.formula: 100 minus bounded penalties for locales without a documented backup review path

recovery_actions: Assign a backup reviewer for each release-critical locale.
Keep release-critical terminology and review guidance in the repository.
limitations: Does not judge translation quality or infer personal availability.
Does not modify translation platforms or files.
